coaching_rationale: High-fatigue adaptation applied: eliminated spinal compressive load due to lumbar tightness and 4.5h sleep. Substituted Barbell Squat for Machine Hack Squat (SFR +40% for quads) and Barbell Row for Chest-Supported T-Bar Row. Restructured into Antagonist Paired Sets (APS) and Myo-reps to compress session time to 28 minutes while securing 9 high-tension effective hypertrophy sets.

adapted_workout.title: Adapted Hypertrophy: High-SFR Quad & Pull Blast (30-min Express)

exercises.biomechanical_notes: Feet low on platform for maximal knee flexion and quad stretch; eliminate spinal shear.
Torso hinged forward for peak hamstring stretch. Paired with Hack Squats to cut rest overhead.
1 heavy activation set to 1 RIR, rest 15s, execute 3 mini-sets of 3 reps. Achieves 4 straight sets of tension in 3.5 minutes.
